# Portfolio Project Instructions

This is a professional portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Main HTML file with all sections
- `css/styles.css` - All styling and responsive design
- `js/main.js` - JavaScript for interactivity
- `assets/` - Directory for images and media files

## Features
- Responsive navigation with mobile hamburger menu
- Hero section with call-to-action
- About, Education, Skills, Experience, and Projects sections
- Contact form with validation
- Social media links
- Smooth scroll behavior
- Mobile-responsive design

## Customization
1. Replace placeholder text with your actual information
2. Update the social media links in the contact section
3. Add your projects to the Projects section
4. Update skills, education, and experience sections
5. Add project images to the `assets/images/` directory

## Running the Project
Simply open `index.html` in a web browser. No build process required!

## Browser Support
Works on all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
